zh: 一个串是否合法只取决于它末尾连续元音的个数是否始终不超过 k，所以按“结尾有几个连续元音”分类计数就够了。
设 dp[j] 为当前长度下以恰好 j 个连续元音结尾的串数。追加辅音（21 种）把 j 归零；追加元音（5 种）把 j 变成 j+1，超过 k 的状态直接丢弃。
初始 dp[0]=1；每一步新 dp[0]=(所有 dp 之和)×21，新 dp[j]=旧 dp[j−1]×5（1≤j≤k），全部对 10⁹+7 取模。重复 n 次后输出 dp 之和取模，时间 O(nk)。
en: Whether a string is valid only depends on its trailing run of consecutive vowels never exceeding k, so it is enough to group strings by the length of that trailing run.

Let dp[j] be the number of strings of the current length ending with exactly j consecutive vowels. Appending a consonant (21 choices) resets j to 0; appending a vowel (5 choices) turns j into j + 1, and states above k are discarded.

Start with dp[0] = 1. Each step, the new dp[0] = (sum of all dp) * 21 and the new dp[j] = old dp[j - 1] * 5 for 1 <= j <= k, all modulo 10^9 + 7. After n steps output the sum of dp modulo 10^9 + 7; the time is O(nk).

explanationEn:
## Approach

dp[j] is the number of strings currently ending in exactly j consecutive vowels. Appending a consonant resets j to 0; appending a vowel increases j by 1, but j may not exceed k.

## Correctness

The last character of any non-empty string falls into exactly one of two classes, consonant or vowel, and multiplying by 21 or 5 accounts for the character choices. The transitions keep the length of the trailing vowel run exactly, and transitions beyond k are dropped, so exactly all valid strings are counted.

## Complexity

O(nk) time and O(k) space.
